properties.informative_only: optional boolean; extraction only, no PASS/FAIL impact
properties.link_evidence: optional boolean; when true, attach bbox evidence from pdf_blocks
properties.depends_on_fields: optional list of strict field names for consolidated LLM evaluation

extraction.understand_document: default true — infer regions/roles from layout-aware blocks before LLM extract

field_properties.semantic_role: e.g. recipient, issuer, document_total, line_item — disambiguates duplicate labels
field_properties.extraction_hint: optional natural-language hint for contextual extraction
field_properties.llm_fallback: optional boolean; when true (or type date), Ollama fills the field if regex/layout miss

llm_validation_policy: Strict rules are never evaluated by LLM. Open-ended evaluation uses allowed tags only.
